result.title: Gnomon4D: Learning Where and When to Focus for Geometric Motion-Grounded World-Action Modeling
result.summary: World-action models (WAMs) use video-generation priors to jointly predict future observations and robot actions. Yet RGB futures entangle physical state changes with appearance, while frame-wise depth and point maps lack temporal correspondence. Existing 4D approaches either keep motion implicit in visual features or translate predicted traces into actions through a separate interface. We present Gnomon4D, a WAM that jointly generates future video, robot actions, and GeoDelta, a video-aligned 4D geometric motion field encoding the cross-frame image-plane displacement and depth change of embodiment and object points. By placing embodiment motion and object responses in a shared space, GeoDelta exposes their motion relations to the action expert at inference. Interaction-Salient Attention (InSAttn) uses these relations to focus spatial readout on task-relevant interaction regions, while Transition-Anchored Aggregation (TransAgg) aggregates evidence around changes in their relative motion, such as grasp and release. GeoDelta describes surface motion independently of embodiment-specific controls, providing a shared human--robot quasi-action for action-free pretraining on EgoManip-5000H followed by robot mid-training on Robot-30H. Gnomon4D leads on RoboTwin~2.0, VLABench, and RoboDojo, and outperforms the strongest real-robot baseline by 7.0 and 16.0 percentage points under in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings, respectively.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Gnomon4D 这一类 world-action 模型，在预测未来视频与机器人动作的同时生成与视频对齐的 4D 几何运动场 GeoDelta，并用交互显著性注意力与转场锚定聚合聚焦交互区域和相对运动突变事件。
AI.relevance_reason: GeoDelta 以跨帧位移与深度变化构成压缩几何状态，其「在哪里读取证据、何时聚合并触发转场」的机制可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、动态计算与停止决策提供线索，但任务属机器人动作生成，迁移可行性需核查。
